title: UI Overlay Integration Slice
summary: UI Overlay Integration Slice — runtime shells, overlay loop, validation runway
context: Post-order 044 lull complete, runtime shells seeded but still minimal. Objective is to deliver a coherent UI overlay slice that exercises narration and telemetry pipelines while locking in validation coverage before scaling wider.

directives.details: Run tools/exchange_heartbeat.py, tools/offline_sync_exchange.py, and tools/contract_test_runner.py to capture a clean readiness snapshot. Log drift or failures before implementation moves forward.
Expand narration and telemetry shells in golf_00/delta_00/alfa_02 and alfa_03 with logging hygiene, comfort toggles, and hook points for overlay events. Document entry points and config knobs.
Implement a single end-to-end UI overlay interaction that flows through the comfort loop, emitting narrator cues and telemetry signals into existing pipelines. Capture traces for validation.
Add a UI overlay to exchange regression case to the contract suite covering overlay trigger, log capture, narrator output, and exchange report generation. Ensure the full suite passes locally.
Update comfort guides and planning chronicle with operator steps, overlay flow notes, and stretch backlog carve-outs. Flag stretch candidates such as cross-workspace rollout separately.
Submit ledger updates plus a completion report under exchange/reports/inbox/order-2025-11-09-045-report.json summarizing evidence and open stretch items.

success_criteria: Baseline readiness sweep captured with heartbeat, offline sync, and contract logs stored in evidence.
Runtime shells in alfa_02 and alfa_03 expose documented overlay hooks, toggles, and logging safeguards.
UI overlay slice demonstrably flows through narrator and telemetry pipelines with trace artifacts attached.
Contract suite includes and passes a UI overlay to exchange regression scenario.
Comfort and planning docs updated with runbook guidance and tracked stretch backlog.
